title: 第4章 神通
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
买完石料后，林玄没有多作停留。

    直到回到小院，关上屋门后，林玄紧绷的心神才终于松了半分。

    他没有立刻去看储物袋，而是先走到窗边，透过缝隙朝外看了一眼。

    确认无人关注后，林玄这才重新坐回石床之上，心念一动，唤出了装备栏。

    下一刻，一道青色光幕悄然浮现在他的眼前。

    光幕之上，共有五个方格。

    其中第一个方格，已经被一枚巴掌大小的土黄色鳞片占据。

    这枚鳞片边缘粗粝厚重，表面布满细密纹路。

    隐约可见一缕缕土黄色灵光缓缓流转，似有山岳伏于其中。

    【已装备：四阶中品灵物，土龙鳞】

    【获得神通：搜山、地飨】

    林玄闭上眼，按照冥冥之中浮现出的感应，开始调动体内灵力。

    “搜山。”

    念头落下的一刹那，装备栏中的土龙鳞微微一亮。

    林玄只觉体内灵力骤然一沉，像是被什么厚重之物牵引着，顺着经脉缓缓下坠，最终没入脚下大地之中。

    下一刻，他脑海中轰然一震。

    一幅无比庞杂的图景，忽然在意识深处展开。

    不是寻常的平面地图，而是一幅近乎立体的山川地脉图。

    岑山坊市、陈氏族地、玄府山中的灵脉走向、地气变化，此刻全都清晰地呈现在林玄脑海之中。

    群山如脊，地脉如络。

    灵气在其中流转，或浓或淡，或聚或散。

    林玄甚至能看见一道道细微的灵光，像星点一样散落在这片山川之中。

    这些星点，便是山中埋藏的灵物，密密麻麻，远比他想象的多。

    片刻之后，两行信息浮现。

    【搜山范围：玄府山灵脉】

    【探得灵物：一阶灵物，三百五十七处；二阶灵物，三处；三阶灵物，一处】

    林玄心中有些惊诧。

    他原以为玄府山被陈氏经营近千年，灵物早已被搜刮得差不多了。

    可如今借助神通一看，才发现这片山川地脉之下竟仍藏着如此多的灵物。

    不过很快，林玄冷静下来。

    只因这三百五十七处一阶灵物中，足足有三百二十五处，都深藏在山体内部，且大多数还都是矿石一类的灵材。
content_en:
After buying the stones, Lin Xuan didn't stay much longer.

    It wasn't until he returned to the courtyard and closed the door that Lin Xuan's tense mind finally relaxed.

    He didn't look at the storage bag immediately. Instead, he walked to the window and looked out through the gap.

    After confirming that no one was paying attention, Lin Xuan sat back on the stone bed and called up the equipment column with a thought.

    The next moment, a cyan light curtain quietly appeared in front of his eyes.

    There are five squares above the light curtain.

    The first square among them has been occupied by an earth-yellow scale the size of a palm.

    The edges of this scale are rough and thick, and the surface is covered with fine lines.

    There are faintly visible wisps of earthy yellow spiritual light flowing slowly, as if there are mountains lying in it.

    [Equipped: Fourth-level mid-grade spiritual object, earth dragon scale]

    [Acquire magical powers: Search Mountain, Diyin]

    Lin Xuan closed his eyes and began to mobilize the spiritual power in his body according to the induction that emerged from somewhere.

    "Soushan."

    The moment the thought fell, the earth dragon scale in the equipment slot lit up slightly.

    Lin Xuan felt that the spiritual power in his body suddenly sank, as if being pulled by something heavy, slowly falling along the meridians, and finally submerged into the ground beneath his feet.

    The next moment, there was a shock in his mind.

    An extremely complex picture suddenly unfolded deep in his consciousness.

    It is not an ordinary flat map, but an almost three-dimensional map of mountains and rivers.

    The direction of the spiritual veins and the changes in the earth's atmosphere in Censhanfang City, the Chen Clan, and Xuanfu Mountain were all clearly presented in Lin Xuan's mind at this moment.

    The mountains are like ridges, and the earth's veins are like networks.

    Spiritual energy flows in it, either thick or thin, gathering or dispersing.

    Lin Xuan could even see tiny spiritual lights scattered like stars in the mountains and rivers.

    These star points are the spiritual objects buried in the mountain. They are densely packed and far more numerous than he imagined.

    After a while, two lines of information appeared.

    [Scope of Search Mountain: Xuanfu Mountain Spiritual Veins]

    [Spiritual objects detected: first-order spiritual objects, three hundred and fifty-seven places; second-order spiritual objects, three places; third-order spiritual objects, one place]

    Lin Xuan was a little surprised.

    He originally thought that Xuanfu Mountain had been managed by the Chen family for nearly a thousand years and that most of the spiritual objects had been looted.

    But now, with the help of magical powers, I discovered that there are still so many spiritual objects hidden under the mountains and rivers.

    But soon, Lin Xuan calmed down.

    Just because of the 357 first-level spiritual objects, a full 325 are hidden deep inside the mountain, and most of them are spiritual materials such as ores.
